instruction: Set VLC's stream output directory to the Desktop folder

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring VLC's stream output directory to Desktop. The evaluator checks if 'sout-file-append' or 'sout-standard-path' in vlcrc is set to '/home/user/Desktop'.
